summary: This informational document looks at privacy risks of application protocols that use IP broadcast or multicast for things like service discovery or name resolution. A passive observer on the local network can learn information from such messages. It gives considerations for designers and users.

eli5.summary: Shouting in a classroom lets everyone hear. This explains how protocols that shout on the network can reveal things about you.

questions: what are the privacy risks of ip multicast
how do broadcast protocols leak information
